world_model_delta: Allied factions may share a SHARED_POOL: each ally contributes a declared amount at alliance formation. Pool may be drawn by either ally at cost of 1 QUINT_CORE per draw. Pool splits 50/50 on ALLIANCE_COLLAPSE. Shared pool is simulation-local; no governance claim arises from contribution.
validator_question: Does shared pool contribution imply co-ownership or governance co-title?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: MEDIUM — pool contribution could imply co-title; explicit: pool is mechanical resource sharing, not governance co-ownership
